primary_purpose: Test whether inversion clusters precede crowded-position unwinds
paper_claim_or_gate: Mechanism gate: bond-market signal should predict unwind of speculative long positions in high-carry currencies
required_interactions: public synchronized-easing proxy; documented currency crosswalk; lagged BIS policy-rate carry membership
merge_keys: assumed public release month; currency; contract code
timing_rule: Assume release three calendar days after report date and retain only the final assumed-available report in each month
target_outputs: CFTC position panel; public-proxy event-study figure; mechanism result ledger
keep_rule: Retained as directional public-proxy evidence because seven direct contracts can be matched; not promoted as confirmation because randomization inference is imprecise
known_limitations: Sparse before September 1992; legacy categories are coarse; NOK and SEK absent; DEM/EUR is a documented proxy; historical release lag is assumed

primary_purpose: Separate a U.S. common term-premium component from expected-rate-path movements
paper_claim_or_gate: Alternative-explanation gate: synchronized inversions should not be only a common U.S. term-premium state
timing_rule: Use monthly ACM estimates and measure changes from month t-1 through each event horizon
target_outputs: Expected-rate versus term-premium public-proxy diagnostic and event-study figure
keep_rule: Retained online: expected-rate component moves directionally while the 10-year term premium does not; family-adjusted inference is not decisive
known_limitations: U.S. Treasury 10-year model only; not a foreign-country 10Y-minus-2Y decomposition; current-vintage

primary_purpose: Measure delivered policy easing after signal onset; construct public policy-rate ranks; screen two- and three-country sensor combinations
paper_claim_or_gate: Mechanism gate: a growth-scare interpretation should predict subsequent easing or expected easing; exploratory gate: determine whether particular policy-rate combinations identify unusually weak shadow-carry episodes
required_interactions: BIS FX; CFTC; ACM; OECD G7 CLI; FRED controls; country-combination enumeration and maxT correction
timing_rule: Define an onset only after three quiet months; carry ranks use the previous month's policy differential; combination onsets use the same delivered-easing rule and require at least six episodes in the baseline screen
target_outputs: Synchronized-easing episode ledger; public carry ranks; all public-proxy mechanism outputs; country-combination results, sensitivity tables, and rotation reference
keep_rule: Retained online as the event proxy, rank input, and exploratory sensor screen; explicitly downstream of and not a substitute for the unavailable IYC signal
known_limitations: Policy-rate concepts change historically and do not equal expected short rates; early observations can be representative rather than official target rates; combination screen is multiple-tested and sensitive to event-count thresholds

primary_purpose: Build a public shadow replication of the spot-return leg, verify quote direction, and score country-combination events
paper_claim_or_gate: Reproducibility gate: public data should reproduce the sign and broad timing of currency losses; exploratory sensor-versus-risk-bearer check
required_interactions: lagged BIS policy-rate rank; synchronized-easing proxy; country-combination onset ledger
timing_rule: Normalize every downloaded series from local-currency-per-USD to the USD return on foreign currency; use a one-month-lagged rank; calculate the same two-month shadow-carry outcome for every eligible pair and triple
target_outputs: Public currency panel; shadow carry spot event response; HAC and sensitivity diagnostics; family-adjusted country-combination screen
keep_rule: Retained online as a shadow spot association only; no reconciliation or country-driver claim is made without the author panel
known_limitations: Not actual forward returns; spot leg omits interest income and costs; euro data are not a verified DEM splice before 1999; selected combinations can be crisis-sensitive
